chapters + corrections found + workings performed. CARRY:
EarthmanChroniclesHost reads at start_new_run. ≥1 FLAG per tier.

currency.name: SHENIN NOTES
currency.earn_line: a finished reading pays notes · corrections found and workings performed count

upgrades.name: A KYRINDI COIN PURSE
upgrades.blurb: twelve shenin saved from a reading already taken. the Talikan market recognizes old money.

upgrades.name: ROCHA'S UNDERLINES
upgrades.blurb: her pencil is already in your copy. you begin holding the first correction — the Pasadena fire — with four still findable.

upgrades.name: A LETTER OF CREDIT
upgrades.blurb: drawn on a Culver City bank that does not exist on Barsoom, honored anyway. twelve more shenin at the first page.

upgrades.name: THE FIELD ALTAR
upgrades.blurb: folding brass, consecrated once, stays consecrated. Working I begins the reading already performed — its recognitions open from page one.

upgrades.name: SARA'S RIBBON
upgrades.blurb: she marked a page for you in a reading that has already happened. carrying it, the finale opens on her private word to you — she knows you have heard the refusal before, and says so.
